891.name: Bars Kickover & pullover Clinic| Ages 5+ | March 20th
891.description:
Bars Kickover & Pullover clinic

Friday, March 20th, 6:30-7:30PM

Girl's Ages 5+

$30

Our specialized skill clinics provide students with the opportunity to work with our experienced coaches on new drills and techniques to take their skills to the next level.

What to Wear & Bring to KNO 

For Clinics, students should wear either a leotard or comfortable athletic attire that allows them to move freely. Please avoid clothing with buttons, zippers, or snaps, as these can be uncomfortable and unsafe during activity. Hair should be pulled back securely out of the face. Students will participate barefoot, so they can arrive in any type of shoes. Be sure to bring a water bottle to stay hydrated during Clinics!

892.name: Early Release/Homeschool Open Gym | Ages 5+ | March 11th
892.description:
Open Gym 

Wednesday, March 11th

1:15PM-3:15PM- Drop in anytime

Co-ed Ages 5+

$20 

Get ready for an exciting night of gymnastics and ninja fun at Open Gym!
Join us for an action-packed evening featuring open gym time on vault, bars, beam, and floor, plus high-energy ninja challenges like obstacle courses, climbing, and games. Our experienced and enthusiastic staff will guide participants through structured activities and open play time. No experience is needed — just bring your energy and get ready for flips, tricks, and tons of fun with friends.

What to Wear & Bring

Your child can wear a leotard or a fitted t-shirt that covers the belly, along with shorts or leggings. Kiddos will go barefoot in the gym, so no special shoes are needed, and hair should be pulled back out of the face. Be sure to bring a water bottle!

861.name: Week 1: Tropical Vacation| Ninja Warrior Summer Camp Full Day | Ages 5-12 | May 26th (NO CAMP ON MONDAY)
861.description:
Summer Camp - Ninja Warrior Full Day Camp (NO CAMP ON MONDAY)

Ages 5-13

$315/ Week or $70/day

School's out and camp is in! Tackle our epic ninja course, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Co-Ed Ninja Camps. Campers will enjoy open gym, structured ninja and trampoline rotations, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun. We provide one morning snack per child each day. If your child would like an additional snack, feel free to pack one from home. For those attending full-day camp, please make sure to send a packed lunch, as lunch is not provided.

What to Wear & Bring to Class

Kids should wear comfortable athletic clothing—think t-shirts, tank tops, shorts, or leggings—that allows them to move freely and safely. Please avoid clothing with zippers, buttons, or snaps, as these can get caught on equipment or cause discomfort. Closed-toe athletic shoes with non-slip soles are required for the ninja course; shoes should have secure fastenings like laces or Velcro to stay firmly in place. Slip-on or loose-fitting shoes are not allowed. Long hair should be tied back neatly, and don’t forget to pack a water bottle to help your child stay hydrated throughout class!

Camp Details:

  • Camp is Non-Refundable
  • Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability
  • Must pre-register & pre-pay

Summer Camp - Girls Gymnastics Full Day Camp

Ages 5-13

$315/Week or $70/day

 

School's out and camp is in! Learn gymnastics skills, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Girls Gymnastics Camps. Each week features an exciting new theme to keep your kids entertained and active all summer long! Campers will participate in structured rotations on vault, bars, beam, and floor, as well as open gym, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun. For those attending full-day camp, please make sure to send a packed lunch, as lunch is not provided.

 

What to Wear & Bring to Class

For Girls Gymnastics Camp, your child can wear a leotard or a fitted t-shirt that covers the belly, along with shorts or leggings. Campers go barefoot in the gym, so no special shoes are needed, and hair should be pulled back out of the face. If your child would like to try the Ninja equipment during Open Gym, please pack a pair of tennis shoes.

 

Camp Details:

  • Camp is Non-Refundable
  • Campers will be separated into groups based on age and ability
  • Must pre-register & pre-pay
